lessonTitle: §1.6 · Từ vector sang ma trận dữ liệu
purpose: Bộ ví dụ và phép dẫn xuất kiểm được cho compatibility, assembly, indexing/slicing, convention translation, NumPy orientation, mean/centering và các downstream boundaries của §1.6. Artifact độc lập với giao diện, dùng CASE_C01_L06_V1_LOCKED và không thay đổi runtime.
globalRules: All UGV engineering-case numbers are copied from or exactly derived from CASE_C01_L06_V1_LOCKED.
The active project convention is X in R^(m x n): observations are rows and ordered features are columns.
Every shape statement names the represented axes; equal shape alone never establishes semantic compatibility.
Observation IDs/timestamps and feature schema/units travel with every row, column or slice.
F07 is a forbidden shortcut, F08/F09 are API equivalents, and F11/F12/F15–F18 remain preview or assumption scoped.
No scale vector, numerical-rank tolerance, retained dimension, PCA component, anomaly threshold or physical fault conclusion is invented.
No runtime file may consume this artifact before academic acceptance.

examples.title: Compatibility gate: cùng shape vẫn có thể không cùng nghĩa
examples.problem: Audit bốn candidate batches so với CASE_C01_L06_V1_LOCKED: swapped wheel columns, omega_left đổi sang rpm nhưng metadata vẫn rad/s, orientation 6x8, và schema-version mismatch.

derivation.statement: Canonical batch có shape 8x6, ordered features [omega_left, omega_right, a_long, a_lat, yaw_rate, battery_current], units [rad/s, rad/s, m/s^2, m/s^2, rad/s, A].
Swapped wheel columns có thể vẫn shape 8x6 nhưng column 0/1 không còn đúng locked feature order; reject trước stack/model use.
Variant đổi omega_left sang rpm nhưng giữ unit rad/s có cùng shape và feature name, nhưng unit contract sai; reject.
Variant 6x8 thay đổi orientation: features trở thành rows và observations thành columns; nó không phải canonical X_raw.
Schema-version mismatch có thể giữ toàn bộ values/shape nhưng phá interface version; reject.
Chỉ canonical locked case qua đủ structural + semantic gates.

qualityChecks: Equal shape is not used as proof of compatibility.
Feature order, unit and schema version are all checked.
No numeric repair/transposition is used to hide a contract failure.

examples.title: Ghép tám observation vectors thành canonical X_raw 8x6
examples.problem: Cho tám locked UGV observations x^(1),...,x^(8) in R^6. Lập ma trận theo project convention.

derivation.statement: Mỗi x^(i) là observation column vector trong R^6 trước khi ghép.
F01 đặt x^(i)^T thành row i: X_raw=[x^(1)^T;...;x^(8)^T].
Số observations m=8 và số ordered features n=6 nên X_raw in R^(8x6).
API-equivalent F08 là np.stack(observations, axis=0) hoặc np.vstack sau compatibility gate.
Row identities remain UGV-W01...UGV-W08 and timestamps remain ordered 250 ms apart.

qualityChecks: All eight locked observations are preserved in order.
No feature permutation is introduced.
API syntax is labeled equivalent to, not stronger than, the semantic contract.

examples.title: Entry, row và column: một index luôn cần semantic label
examples.problem: Giải thích X_raw[2,4], X_raw[2,:] và X_raw[:,4] theo zero-based Python indexing.

derivation.statement: Row index 2 maps to UGV-W03, timestamp 2026-07-09T10:00:00.500Z.
Column index 4 maps to yaw_rate with unit rad/s.
Do đó X_raw[2,4]=0.08 rad/s là yaw_rate của UGV-W03.
F03 gives X_raw[2,:]=[9.0,9.4,0.25,0.11,0.08,12.9], still tied to UGV-W03 and the six-feature schema.
F04 gives X_raw[:,4]=[-0.02,0.04,0.08,-0.05,-0.10,-0.04,0.06,0.11], a feature trajectory over eight observations.
Timestamp remains row metadata; it is not silently appended as a seventh feature.

qualityChecks: Entry meaning includes observation and feature identity.
Feature unit is preserved.
Timestamp is metadata, not an undeclared feature.

examples.title: Block slicing phải slice metadata cùng numeric block
examples.problem: Lấy X_raw[2:5,2:5] và mô tả đầy đủ observation/feature identities.

derivation.statement: Rows 2:5 select UGV-W03, UGV-W04, UGV-W05.
Columns 2:5 select a_long, a_lat, yaw_rate with units m/s^2, m/s^2, rad/s.
Block shape is 3x3, but shape alone does not encode those identities.
Any downstream export of this block must carry the three row IDs/timestamps plus the three ordered feature descriptors.

qualityChecks: Numeric block matches locked case.
Observation and feature metadata are aligned with exactly the same index sets.
No slice is presented as self-describing.

examples.title: Transpose: 8x6 ↔ 6x8 là đổi convention, không phải sửa lỗi
examples.problem: Chuyển canonical X_raw 8x6 sang X_col=X_raw^T và mô tả lại axes.

derivation.statement: Canonical X_raw has shape 8x6: row i=observation i, column j=feature j.
F06 gives X_col=X_raw^T with shape 6x8.
In X_col, row j now corresponds to feature j, while column i corresponds to observation i.
UGV-W03 therefore appears in column 2 of X_col, not row 2.
A formula or API written under row-observation convention must be translated; blindly transposing until multiplication runs is forbidden.

qualityChecks: Both shape and semantic axes are restated after transpose.
No claim treats transpose as a harmless display operation.
No dimension error is repaired blindly.

examples.title: NumPy 1D transpose trap: x.T vẫn là shape (6,)
examples.problem: Cho x=np.array([9.0,9.4,0.25,0.11,0.08,12.9]). So sánh x, x.T, x.reshape(1,6), x.reshape(6,1).

derivation.statement: x.shape==(6,), tức ndarray có một axis; nó chưa mang explicit row/column 2D shape.
x.T.shape vẫn là (6,), nên F07 ghi shortcut này là forbidden nếu mục tiêu là tạo row/column matrix.
x.reshape(1,6) has shape (1,6): explicit single-observation row under project convention.
x.reshape(6,1) has shape (6,1): explicit column vector representation.
np.stack([x1,...,x8],axis=0) yields 8x6; np.column_stack([x1,...,x8]) yields 6x8. Hai outputs có conventions khác nhau.

qualityChecks: Distinguishes mathematical vector notation from ndarray axis behavior.
F07 is explicitly treated as a trap, not a valid orientation conversion.
F08/F09 outputs are named by convention.

examples.title: Linear selector y=Xw kiểm tra feature order bằng chính yaw_rate
examples.problem: Dùng w=e_5=(0,0,0,0,1,0)^T theo locked feature order để tính y=X_raw w.

derivation.statement: X_raw has shape 8x6 and w has shape 6, so F10 yields y in R^8.
Because the fifth locked feature is yaw_rate, w selects column index 4 without mixing units or features.
This exactly matches X_raw[:,4], confirming orientation and feature-order alignment for this selector.
If the columns were silently permuted but w remained unchanged, multiplication would still run while semantic meaning would be wrong.

qualityChecks: Selector is a structural demonstration, not a learned diagnostic model.
Feature order is explicitly part of the multiplication contract.
Code success is not used as proof after a hypothetical permutation.

examples.title: Hai Gram objects có shape và pairwise role khác nhau
examples.problem: Với X_raw in R^(8x6), xác định shapes và pairwise roles của G_f=X_raw^T X_raw và G_o=X_raw X_raw^T.

derivation.statement: X_raw^T has shape 6x8.
F11: G_f=(6x8)(8x6), so G_f in R^(6x6). Its indices pair feature columns under the raw inner-product geometry.
F12: G_o=(8x6)(6x8), so G_o in R^(8x8). Its indices pair observation rows under the raw inner-product geometry.
Both are Gram-type matrices, but they live in different index spaces.
Because raw columns mix rad/s, m/s^2 and A, magnitude comparisons are preprocessing-sensitive and must not be overinterpreted.

qualityChecks: Shapes are derived before interpretation.
Raw mixed-unit geometry warning is retained.
Neither object is called covariance automatically.

examples.title: Raw Gram không phải covariance: yaw_rate làm counterexample số
examples.problem: So sánh raw yaw_rate Gram diagonal với sample variance của yaw_rate sau centering.

derivation.statement: Its raw self-product is sum(x_i^2)=0.0382; this is one diagonal entry of X_raw^T X_raw, not sample variance.
F13 gives locked yaw_rate mean mu_yaw=0.01.
The centred sum of squares is 0.0374.
Under preview-only F16, sample variance is 0.0374/(8-1)=0.005342857142857143.
The difference demonstrates why raw Gram, centering and normalization divisor must not be conflated.

qualityChecks: Uses only locked yaw_rate values and locked mean.
F16 is labeled preview and assumption scoped.
No PCA/eigendecomposition is inferred from this variance example.

examples.title: Feature-wise mean và centering của UGV-W03
examples.problem: Dùng locked mean để tính centered row cho UGV-W03 và reconstruct raw row.

derivation.statement: Reconstruction X_c[2,:]+mu returns [9.0,9.4,0.25,0.11,0.08,12.9].
Centering changes the reference origin but does not standardize variances or remove mixed units.
For later live/test observations, this reference mean must be reused when the model contract requires it; do not refit silently.

qualityChecks: Centered row exactly matches locked case.
Reconstruction is exact at the locked decimal representation.
Centering and scaling are kept distinct.

examples.title: Centering invariant: mỗi feature column có mean zero trong reference batch
examples.problem: Kiểm tra 1_8^T X_c=0^T cho locked centred matrix.

derivation.statement: X_c keeps shape 8x6 because the same 1x6 mean row is subtracted from every observation.
Sum each locked centred column over the 8 observations.
At exact decimal arithmetic, each column sum is 0; floating arithmetic may show only round-off such as about 5.33e-15 maximum absolute residual.
Therefore feature-wise mean of this reference X_c is zero within numerical tolerance.
This invariant verifies centering; it does not prove scaling, independence, low rank, PCA quality or physical health.

qualityChecks: Numerical tolerance is identified as floating-point verification only.
No rank/PCA or diagnostic conclusion is attached to zero mean.
The reference dataset is named.

examples.title: Scaling boundary và leakage: biết mixed units chưa đủ để chọn X_s
examples.problem: Case có rad/s, m/s^2 và A. Có nên tự động standardize bằng statistics của mỗi incoming batch không?

derivation.statement: F15 writes X_s=X_c D_s^(-1), but D_s must come from a declared policy and reference population.
Mixed units are a reason to question geometry, not a license to invent a particular scale vector.
CASE_C01_L06_V1_LOCKED does not lock D_s in Pass 5, so no numeric X_s is accepted in this lesson pass.
If a downstream model was fitted with reference scaling, recomputing D_s on each test/live batch changes the interface and can leak future/test information.
Correct Pass 8 output is therefore a boundary statement plus contract requirements, not fabricated standardized values.

answer.fitTransformRule: fit on declared reference/training source; reuse for compatible later data

qualityChecks: No scale value is invented.
Leakage/interface drift is named explicitly.
Scaling remains separate from centering.

examples.title: Feature transform preview Y=XA giữ observation axis
examples.problem: Cho X in R^(8x6) và một declared feature transform A in R^(6xp). Suy ra shape và metadata requirements của Y=XA.

derivation.statement: Inner dimension 6 matches the six input features, so multiplication is dimensionally defined.
F17 gives Y in R^(8xp): the 8 observation rows remain aligned with the same UGV IDs/timestamps.
Columns of Y are p transformed features whose definitions/units now depend on A.
A must be authored for the exact locked input feature order; a shape-compatible permutation can silently change results.
This example is shape/contract preview only; no particular A or transformed numeric matrix is invented.

qualityChecks: No transform matrix is fabricated.
Input feature-order contract is explicit.
New output-feature semantics are required rather than assumed.

examples.title: Rank boundary: shape chỉ khóa rank(X)<=6
examples.problem: Với X_raw shape 8x6, điều gì được phép kết luận về rank ở Pass 8?

derivation.statement: F18 gives rank(X)<=min(m,n).
For m=8 and n=6, rank(X_raw)<=6.
This bound is an algebraic shape consequence and requires no SVD result.
Pass 5 did not lock numerical-rank tolerance, and §1.6 does not equate rank with physical UGV mode count.
Therefore no exact/numerical rank value or number of physical modes is accepted here.

qualityChecks: Only the locked shape-based bound is claimed.
No SVD/numerical tolerance is introduced.
Physical interpretation remains deferred.

examples.title: PCA và diagnosis boundary: covariance preview chưa phải kết luận
examples.problem: Giả sử sample covariance preview đã được tính đúng từ X_c. Có thể kết luận principal components, retained dimension hoặc UGV fault không?

derivation.statement: F16 defines a covariance object only after centering, orientation and normalization assumptions are declared.
Principal components still require an eigendecomposition/SVD convention plus an explicit scaling choice where relevant.
Retained dimension requires a criterion such as explained-variance policy that is not locked in Pass 8.
Low variance of one raw/centred feature does not prove that feature is useless for every downstream task.
An unusual matrix/data-quality pattern can motivate investigation but does not identify a mechanical/electrical fault without a diagnostic model and evidence.
Thus Pass 8 stops at the validated data matrix and bounded previews; full SVD/PCA/model selection/diagnosis stay deferred.

qualityChecks: No component or retained-dimension result is fabricated.
No variance-to-importance shortcut is accepted.
No data audit is turned into a physical diagnosis.
